prompt: Who was the last Miss World America to place in the Top 11 at Miss World? Hint: She has pursued a modeling career.
answer: Audra Mari was the last Miss World America to place in the Top 11 at Miss World. She won Miss World America 2016, placed sixth (Top 11) at Miss World 2016, and pursued a modeling career.
